# `convert_timezone`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts the timestamp without time zone `sourceTs` from the `sourceTz` time zone to `targetTz`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
convert_timezone([sourceTz, ]targetTz, sourceTs)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- convert_timezone, example 1
> SELECT convert_timezone('Europe/Brussels', 'America/Los_Angeles', timestamp_ntz'2021-12-06 00:00:00');
2021-12-05 15:00:00
```

```sql
-- convert_timezone, example 2
> SELECT convert_timezone('Europe/Brussels', timestamp_ntz'2021-12-05 15:00:00');
2021-12-06 00:00:00
```
